ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) covering the central 85% of visible surface area, with high-intensity (white) patches concentrated at the distal tips and along portions of the trailing edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous low-intensity black central mass; high-intensity white pigmentation localized to the lateral tips and margins of both lobes, featuring diffuse mottling and pixel-level speckling that tapers toward the fluke center.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 115-120 degrees and a depth-to-width ratio of roughly 1:15.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Asymmetrical topography; the distal end of the right lobe displays high-amplitude, irregular jagged peaks and valleys (notches); the left lobe trailing edge displays lower-amplitude, more uniform scalloping.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Main body follows a broad convex curve transitioning to a pronounced upward and outward sweep toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Several small, circular high-intensity pixel clusters (scars) detected within the white pigmentation zones on the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct, unaligned linear white streaks (rake marks) crossing the black pigmentation, notably a cluster of vertical marks in the upper-mid region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular, jagged tissue loss at the terminal end of the right lobe trailing edge, indicating healed physical trauma or amputation of the tip margin.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique vertical linear rake mark pair located near the center of the right lobe, contrasting sharply against the solid black background.
